tableRows: Easy AppointmentsDocumented self-hosted appointment plugin marketed for clinics and health practices (plugin version 4.0.3). WordPress admin screens cover locations, services, workers, an appointments list, a customer list, custom form fields, and CSV export. Weight history, medication, or health-condition questions are custom fields you add (textarea, select, or input); they are not documented defaults. Emails can include those custom fields.
